situation: A Consumer Brands & Retail account is evaluating Data & Context for customer service conversations. It would pay through pure consumption. A brand failure can go viral in an afternoon, and seasonal spikes make variable costs swing sharply.

consumption_profile.seasonality: it triples over the holiday peak

forecast.speaker: VP Digital / E-Commerce
forecast.partial: There is a lot of volume in customer service conversations and it keeps growing, but I would need to pull the exact numbers.
forecast.verbatim: We handle 2.5 million conversations a month today, growing about 25 percent a year, and it triples over the holiday peak.

ramp.speaker: VP Digital / E-Commerce
ramp.partial: We will not sign a large commit on queries before we see real usage.
ramp.verbatim: We can commit to 40 percent of that forecast in year one and run the rest on demand until usage proves out.
